decisions: Headline: 'Nobody Stands a Chance Against Me' replaces the draft's 'No One Stands a Chance With Me'; the Hebrew 'אין לאף אחד סיכוי איתי' is a boast about being unbeatable, and 'against me' is how English says it. The same wording closes the piece.
'פרגית צעירה וחלקה' rendered 'a smooth young spring chicken': the poultry image is kept literally with 'smooth' carrying the hairless-twink sense; no English slang substituted.
'כל העולם ואחיו הגיי' rendered 'the whole world and its gay brother', a one-word twist on the English idiom matching the Hebrew twist.
Section heading 'רוצה תיאטרון' rendered 'He'd Rather Do Theater' (a literal 'Wants Theater' is not an English heading).
'שיגרמו לגל אוחובסקי קצת נחת' rendered 'that should warm the heart of Gal Uchovsky'.
'מתמזמזים' rendered 'making out'; 'הפציצה את המרקע' rendered 'bombarded the screen' without intensifying.
Established title Queer as Folk throughout; Glee and Desperate Housewives as in the Hebrew.
Long Hebrew sentence listing the visit's events rebuilt as one English sentence with parallel verbs (take part, speak up, meet, sit, star) so the Uchovsky joke stays in the final clause.
lostInTranslation: The subtitle's Menachem Ben joke needs a four-word gloss in English; in Hebrew it lands on the name alone.
'ארץ הקודש' as a mock-solemn label for Israel reads slightly less tongue-in-cheek in English, where 'the Holy Land' is also a tourism phrase.
defectsFixed: 'the whole world and its gay brother remember the days when you were a young, smooth spring chicken' tightened to 'remember you as a smooth young spring chicken'.
'Randy was identified with Justin' replaced by 'Randy was synonymous with Justin'; 'constantly commenting to him' replaced by 'pointing it out to him all the time'.
'The older I get, the healthier my attitude to the character of Justin becomes' replaced by 'the healthier my relationship with Justin gets'.
'Soon all of us will be able to get a personal look at the change Harrison has undergone' replaced by 'Soon we'll all get to judge the change in Harrison for ourselves'.
'MK' and 'CEO of the Open House' replaced by glosses an English reader can use; 'Social TV' given its first-mention gloss.
'give Gal Uchovsky a bit of satisfaction' replaced by 'warm the heart of Gal Uchovsky'.
Hebrew-order answer sentences ('It happens that on my travels around the world I'm often a guest on...') rebuilt as English sentences throughout.
'throwing a steak into a lions' cage' corrected to 'a lion cage'.
Captions moved directly under their provenance comments, matching the reference files.
